items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: So Russell asked me to work for him and that's when I started playing with Louis Russell.

ctx.x: So they both wanted you to work with that band?
Yeah. The bass player heard me and he went out and got Louis Russell and told him about me. So Russell asked me to work for him and that's when I started playing with Louis Russell.
At that particular time you say you didn't work with Willie Lynch or Chick Webb?
